packageRules.description: Group all non-major devDependency bumps into one PR -- lint/test/build tooling churns often and reviewing it one PR at a time is noise.
Node must stay on 22 -- package.json engines pins '>=22.0.0 <23.0.0' and the Dockerfiles build on 22. A major bump here is a deliberate migration, not a Renovate PR.
@kubernetes/client-node is pinned to one version across 13 packages; a split-version bump breaks the shared k8s.ts helpers. Keep every package moving together.
hono + its node adapter must move together -- the adapter tracks hono's request/response internals.
Pin GitHub Actions by SHA -- the CI workflow documents this as the supply-chain hardening baseline.
